fields.description: Heading this field appears under on the self-service page. Rows sharing a section are grouped in the order they appear here.
fields.label: Section

fields.description: Fieldname on the parent record's Document Type. Its label, type, options and mandatory flag are read from that doctype, never restated here.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: Shown on the page. Clear this to keep a field out of self service entirely.
fields.label: Viewable

fields.description: The owner may propose a change to this field. Proposals still go to whoever reviews them; this only decides what can be asked.
fields.label: Proposable

fields.description: For a Link field whose target may not exist yet, or may be invisible to the owner. They type a value instead of picking one, and whoever reviews the request creates the linked document if it is needed. Nothing is applied until that document exists.
fields.label: Free Form Text
